hints.title: Full Lap Symmetry
hints.text: Every full round from any sector back to that same sector visits every sector on the track an equal number of times.

hints.title: Only Start and End Matter
hints.text: Intermediate waypoints do not alter relative visit frequencies. The most visited sectors are determined purely by rounds[0] and rounds[-1].

hints.title: Circular Interval
hints.text: If start <= end, sectors from start to end receive one extra visit. If start > end, sectors 1 to end and start to n receive one extra visit.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating every single step across all rounds is redundant and takes O(M * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since full loops cancel out, only the net range [start, end] is generated in O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes intermediate rounds are full circular traversals and extract only the net boundary offset.
complexity.notes: Sectors are 1-indexed and returned in ascending order.
